project.name: CSV inventory
project.description: Inspect quoted spreadsheet cells and declared headers, diagnose and repair CSV source, and report low stock with native typed counts and HTML/JSON artifacts.

entries.name: Inspect imported inventory tree
entries.description: Inspect retained string cells, header-derived mapping keys and original source start offsets.

entries.name: Validate inventory CSV source
entries.description: Validate CSV source syntax and declared dialect, separately from inventory count rules.

entries.name: Format CSV for interchange
entries.description: Native compact CSV preserves exact cell values and applies required quoting; LF is the default record separator.

entries.name: Review aligned CSV
entries.description: Native tabular formatting is a visual review presentation, not an import-safe interchange contract.

entries.name: Select low-stock SKUs
entries.description: Compare canonical non-negative integer counts explicitly after native string-cell import; select SKU-A and SKU-C.

entries.name: Inspect declared headerless rows
entries.description: Declared header=absent keeps every record as an array of string cells instead of deriving object keys from its first row.

entries.name: Repair declared header policy
entries.description: Execute the authored native validation configuration. header=maybe is an advisory metadata warning; edit this config to header=present and run again.

entries.name: Repair an unclosed quoted field
entries.description: Intentional native CSV syntax error; README documents the exact source repair.

entries.name: Repair an unescaped field quote
entries.description: Intentional native CSV syntax error; README documents the exact source repair.

entries.name: Repair an incomplete inventory row
entries.description: Native CSV reports row-width drift as an advisory warning, not a syntax failure; repair the missing cell in the ordinary source editor.

entries.name: Build low-stock inventory
entries.description: Publish an HTML table and typed JSON records for low stock. Flag invalid count text explicitly rather than silently coercing it. Select generated/low-stock.html to preview.
